task.description:
WF-03 Step 2 for ISS-0910. Design the fix per ISSUE-FIXER's recommendation (handoffs/WF03-ISS0910-20260930/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnose.json): RoleBackfill.run/0 (lib/letflow/identity/role_backfill.ex) already computes and returns {:ok, %{seeded: [tenant_id], unchanged: [tenant_id]}} -- the seeded list is exactly the set of tenants genuinely affected by this run (held fewer than all six roles before it). Design a fix that, for every tenant in the seeded list, resets role_claims_synced_at to nil for every user with a membership in that tenant, forcing sync_role_claims_from_token/3 to re-run on their next login/token verification (both existing gated call sites in lib/letflow/identity.ex, unchanged).

Specify: (1) the exact query/changeset shape for the reset (which table, which join to scope 'users with a membership in tenant X', a bulk Repo.update_all-shaped operation vs. a per-user changeset loop -- state which and why given this may touch many rows); (2) where in RoleBackfill.run/0's control flow this reset happens (after the seeded list is finalized, or per-tenant during the reduce) and whether it should be in the SAME transaction as the tenant_role/group seeding or a separate one (idempotency and partial-failure implications either way); (3) confirm idempotency explicitly -- running the backfill twice must not error and must not need to reset an already-nil marker a second time in a way that matters; (4) whether this needs a new Ecto migration (unlikely, role_claims_synced_at already exists) -- confirm by checking the users schema; (5) logging/telemetry for how many users' markers were reset, matching the existing style of RoleBackfill's own return-value reporting. Write lib/letflow/design/iss0910-role-backfill-resync-marker-reset.md -- @spec-style signatures and type shapes only, no full function bodies.
acceptance_criteria: the fix resets role_claims_synced_at to nil for users with a membership in each tenant in RoleBackfill.run/0's own :seeded list, not :unchanged tenants
the reset reuses sync_role_claims_from_token/3's existing gated call sites (no new sync-triggering code path invented)
the fix is idempotent -- running the backfill twice does not error and does not incorrectly re-affect already-corrected users
no implementation code in the design doc -- signatures/shapes only
